videos.title: Modern Family
videos.description: When Phil thinks Luke is giving him the cold shoulder, Andy becomes Phil's new right-hand man. Jay is put in a tough spot when it is suspected that Joe is allergic to Stella and Mitchell does some freelance legal work at Jay's company.

videos.title: Modern Family
videos.description: Claire senses that Phil may be more into 'Juliana' than into her. Gloria's sister visits. Mitchell and Cameron get into a situation with Anders.

videos.title: Modern Family
videos.description: Claire takes a first-class seat on a flight, leaving Phil in coach, and Gloria makes Jay teach Manny how to defend himself. Mitch, Cam and their friends throw Sal a belated baby shower.

videos.title: Modern Family
videos.description: While stuck at the airport, Claire partakes in online snooping that creates drama with the rest of the family.

videos.title: Don't Tell the Bride
videos.description: Sonny is a party fanatic. His bride Jasmine is unsure about his plans for a zoo-themed Ibizan beach party with body paint.

videos.title: Don't Tell the Bride
videos.description: The sky's the limit for adrenaline junkie Jai as he plans on having a wedding in the sky, neglecting the fact that his bride-to-be Leanne is terrified of heights.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: Gordon Ramsay revisits Café Hon in Hampden, Maryland, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, to see whether the restaurant owners have taken his advice on board.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: Gordon heads to the historic Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets an owner so stubborn and set in his ways that he doesn't realise he's the reason his restaurant is losing money. Owner Tom bought the business for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he is still refusing to let her run it. Gordon must fight a controlling boss who doesn't react well to his criticism.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: In Beaver, Pennsylvania, where he finds a brother-and-sister team who are unable to work together positively at an Italian restaurant called Levanti's. Their relationship is so fractured that they are failing to save their father's business from being overwhelmed by competition from other local eateries. The situation has become desperate, and dad Tony is now in danger of losing his life savings.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. Within minutes of his arrival, Gordon is caught in the crossfire of an argument between owner Sam, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working in the restaurant seven days a week.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: Gordon heads to Long Beach, California, to save Nino's, an Italian family restaurant that was opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of the eldest son, Nino. Younger brother Michael and sister Carina point the finger of blame for the restaurant's failings directly at Nino, and their 78-year-old mother Inge is desperate for Nino to turn the business around.

videos.title: Turner & Hooch
videos.description: Detective Scott Turner is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. When his friend Amos Reed, the proprietor of a junkyard, is killed, Turner reluctantly inherits the man's dog. Realising that the canine may be able to help him solve the murder case, Turner attempts to adjust to life with the big dog, resulting in much household destruction and unwelcome chaos.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Aunt Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park, with near-disastrous consequences.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart protests by hooking himself up with Tom, a surrogate dad from an agency. Stung by being jilted by his own son, Homer gets into a monster brawl with Tom that even makes the news.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Valentine's Day comes to Springfield and Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card, but when Ralph falls in love with Lisa their friendship turns bad, causing a bitter feud to break out between the two families.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: After Homer fails a breathalyser test-driving home from a visit to the Duff brewery, he is forced to quit drinking for a month. Meanwhile, Lisa buys a hamster for her school science project, in order to prove that Bart is dumber than a rodent.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control. When Homer leads the workers out on strike, Mr Burns retaliates by hiring robots to replace them and shutting off power to the city.

videos.title: The Great British Bake Off
videos.description: The stars of `It's A Sin' join Paul Hollywood, Prue Leith, Matt Lucas and Noel Fielding in the white tent to celebrate Christmas. Olly Alexander, Nathaniel Curtis, Lydia West and Shaun Dooley compete for the coveted Christmas Star Baker title.

videos.description: The nation's favourite armchair critics cast their eyes over 2021's biggest Christmas TV shows and films including 'Michael McIntyre's Christmas Wheel', 'First Dates at Christmas', 'Strictly the Real Full Monty', 'Love Actually' and 'No Time to Die'.

videos.description: Gordon Ramsay continues his travels across the United States in a bid to save failing restaurants from disaster. This week, Gordon visits beachside restaurant Barefoot Bob's in Hull, Massachusetts, owned by husband-and-wife team Marc and Lisa. The duo opened the grill in the summer of 2004 to a busy seafront crowd, but every year the bottom line collapses through the bleak winter months.

videos.title: Don't Tell the Bride
videos.description: Sonny is a party fanatic. His bride Jasmine is unsure about his plans for a zoo-themed Ibizan beach party with body paint.

videos.description: Warren tries his best to support Mercedes, but his scorned ex-girlfriend is never far away. Guilt consumes one resident. Frankie opens up about her past. Sienna, Dodger and the McQueens step in to help new mum Cleo finally get the support she needs.

videos.title: Don't Tell the Bride
videos.description: Will Andy's plans for a skater-themed wedding make his bride Bobby's wheels spin? Or will there be broken bones as well as hearts on the big day?

videos.title: Patrick
videos.description: A teacher's grandmother dies, and she inherits her grandmother's cute but mischievous pug. The dog is only small but has the ability to have a big impact and turn the teacher's life upside down.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: Gordon heads to Norwalk, Ohio, in America's farming heartland, for the first of two visits to the Mill Street Bistro. There he encounters Joe Nagy, one of the most pretentious restaurant owners he has ever met.

videos.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
videos.description: In the dramatic conclusion to the Mill Street Bistro saga, Gordon's disagreement with proprietor Joe Nagy erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet.

videos.description: At his high-school reunion, Homer wins several awards including 'Most Weight Gained' and 'Most Improved Odour', but the Principal takes them away when he finds out that Homer never graduated. Homer vows to graduate and win them back by going to night school.

videos.title: The Simpsons
